title: The legal-pages README imprint example uses a fictional demo identity
detail: The legal-pages README seeds its imprint example with a fictional demo identity and address instead of a real person's details.

title: Optional title heading on legal pages
detail: `LegalPageRoute` has an optional `titleHeading` flag. When `true`, the page body starts with an `<h1>` holding the escaped page title. The default (`false`) leaves the body unchanged.

title: Legal pages fail fast on custom routes without required blocks; seed race honours skip
detail: `createLegalPagesFeature` now throws when custom `routes` cover no default required block and `requiredBlocks` is omitted, instead of failing the production boot check later. The text-block and system-template seed race loser now honours `ifExists: "skip"` and the no-op comparison. `SegmentedSelect` keeps the first segment tabbable when the stored value matches no option. The `subscribePathname` option documents that the `popstate` default misses `pushState` navigation.
